title: Percentile-aware cost attribution and tapered span sampling for bursty token distributions
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: long-tail bursts (e.g., chat sessions and batch spikes) cause noisy p99 token-cost signals and poor alert precision. This PR introduces percentile-aware token cost attribution (per-route+model cardinality) plus a tapered reservoir span-sampling algorithm to preserve long-tail traces during bursts without exploding storage or noise. Changes summary: 1) New aggregated metrics: redwood.token_cost.p{50,90,95,99} (labels: tenant, route, model, quantization_profile) implemented as Prom-compatible histogram rollups and lightweight approximate percentiles for real-time panels. 2) Attribution pipeline: per-request token attribution uses a per-span token counter and an aggregation step that attributes cost to route/model buckets and emits delta metrics at flush. This avoids double-counting across KV cache hits and model-fallback cascades. 3) Tapered reservoir sampling: a new sampler replaces uniform reservoir in edge collectors. The sampler ramps sampling weight down as per-tenant burstiness increases, keeping a fixed memory envelope while preferentially retaining older or high-cost traces. Configuration knobs exposed via runtime flags and Redwood Console: target_sample_budget, taper_half_life_seconds, cost_priority_bias. 4) Alerts and dashboards: revamped SLO dashboard with percentile ribbons, a p99-cost-trend alert rule that uses week-over-week percentile deltas and a minimum-volume guard to reduce noise. Added an examples dashboard template for large-tenant cost debugging (pre-aggregated query panels and query snippets). 5) Migration and rollout plan: the feature is gated behind feature flag observability.percentile_cost and ramps by tenant tier (dev->staging->enterprise) with a canary that forwards both old and new metrics for 48 hours. Backwards compatibility: legacy token_cost.{avg,sum} metrics still emitted for 90 days; dashboards default to new percentiles but include toggles. Implementation notes: changes touch collectors, ingestion pipeline, metric exporter and Console UI; introduced a small C++ sampler component compiled into the collector binary and a Go sidecar for attribution flush coordination. Performance: local perf harness shows 6% CPU on collectors at 10k rps with 1% memory overhead; ingestion tail-latency unchanged within measurement noise. Why different: previous PRs added token timing, mikro-rollups, or span sampling variants; this one focuses on accurate percentile-aware cost attribution combined with an adaptive sampling strategy that keeps representative long-tail traces under bursty loads. Rollback: feature flag off or toggle sample_budget=0 reverts to baseline. Requested follow-ups: automated regression tests for attribution correctness, a migration playbook for enterprise customers with large historical dashboards, and a monitoring smoke test to validate percentiles match historical aggregates within tolerance.

review_comments: Omar: We need a safety valve for sampler memory under pathological multi-tenant bursts; can we add a hard cap? Author: added max_memory_bytes and a fallback LRU when budget exceeded.

Priya: Attribution correctness question — how do we handle model fallbacks that generate extra tokens? Author: attribution tags each fallback span with origin_model and an attribution_deduct flag; flush step dedupes tokens by request id and origin to avoid double-counting.
Jonas: CI noticed a flaky test in attributor_test.go on macOS runners. Author: adjusted test timing and added a retry harness; test now stable in our CI matrix.

SRE (comment): recommend an alert to detect sudden divergence between legacy sum-based cost and new percentile aggregates. Author: added alert 'token_cost_percentile_divergence' with 15m window and RTV guard.
Security: confirm no PII flows into percentiles. Author: confirmed attribution tags are keys-only and all request identity is hashed and truncated before export.
ci_checks: benchmarks: pass (6% CPU overhead at 10k rps)
release_notes: Added percentile-aware token cost metrics (p50/p90/p95/p99), tapered reservoir sampling for bursty workloads, UI dashboard template for percentile cost debugging, and new alert rules to reduce noisy p99 alerts. Feature gated and phased rollout.
notes_for_release: Enable observability.percentile_cost for staging and run the canary for 48h. Verify token_cost_percentile_divergence alert is silent or acknowledged. If issues, flip flag off to revert to legacy metrics.
